sect1.title: Introduction
sect1.para: The TopTruthJets class, implemented in Cython, is a specialized selection template within the AnalysisG framework, designed for comprehensive analysis of truth-level top jets and their underlying parton associations in Monte Carlo 16 (MC16) events. It inherits from the generic SelectionTemplate class, extending its functionalities to extract and organize detailed information about truth-jet masses, parton contributions to truth-jets, and the relationship between truth-jets and top quarks. This class facilitates a high-performance extraction and structuring of truth-level top-jet data for further physics analysis.

sect1.title: The TopTruthJets Class
sect1.para: TopTruthJets is a cdef class, indicating its implementation as a Cython extension type. It inherits from SelectionTemplate, thereby gaining all the base functionalities for event selection, ROOT file interpretation, and weight management. Its primary role is to encapsulate a C++ toptruthjets object, which likely contains the logic for identifying truth-level top jets, associating them with partons, and calculating relevant kinematic properties.

listitem.para: __cinit__(self): The Cython "constructor" equivalent, called during object allocation. It initializes a new C++ toptruthjets object and assigns its pointer to self.ptr. It then upcasts self.ptr to a toptruthjets* and assigns it to self.tt for specialized access.
__init__(self): (Not explicitly defined in the provided snippet) This would typically be the Python initializer.
__dealloc__(self): The Cython "destructor" equivalent, called upon object deallocation. It deallocates the C++ toptruthjets object pointed to by self.tt, ensuring proper memory management.

cdef void transform_dict_keys(self): This method is responsible for converting the C++ data structures within the underlying toptruthjets object into Python dictionaries and lists, making them accessible as properties of the TopTruthJets instance.
self.top_mass: Populated from self.tt.top_mass (masses of top quarks).
self.truthjet_partons: Populated from self.tt.truthjet_partons (partons associated with truth-jets).
self.truthjets_contribute: Populated from self.tt.truthjets_contribute (contributions of truth-jets to various categories).
self.truthjet_top: Populated from self.tt.truthjet_top (top quarks associated with truth-jets).
self.truthjet_mass: Populated from self.tt.truthjet_mass (masses of truth-jets).
self.ntops_lost: Populated from self.tt.ntops_lost (number of lost top quarks).

sect1.title: C++ Interaction
sect1.para:
The TopTruthJets class leverages Cython's capabilities for seamless C++ integration:
cdef class TopTruthJets: Declares TopTruthJets as a Cython extension type.
cdef toptruthjets *tt: A C++ pointer to a toptruthjets object, which is the specialized C++ implementation for truth-level top-jet analysis.
self.ptr = new toptruthjets(): Initializes the base SelectionTemplate's C++ pointer.
self.tt = <toptruthjets*>self.ptr: This line demonstrates C++ upcasting, allowing TopTruthJets to fulfill the SelectionTemplate interface while internally managing its specific toptruthjets data.
from AnalysisG.core.selection_template cimport SelectionTemplate: Imports the base SelectionTemplate class, from which TopTruthJets inherits.
from AnalysisG.selections.mc16.toptruthjets.toptruthjets cimport *: Imports the C++ toptruthjets class declaration from its .pxd file.
from AnalysisG.core.tools cimport *: Imports utility functions for converting between C++ and Python data structures, specifically as_dict_dict_dict, as_dict_dict, as_dict, and as_list.
